tpms.when: 2011 XF (sensors in each wheel; no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, using an accurate gauge.
There is no reset button. The warning clears once the tires are at the correct pressure and the system reads them again.
Drive above about 18 mph for at least 10 minutes so the system can check every wheel.
If a sensor or wheel was replaced, drive for at least 15 minutes and then leave the car parked for 15 minutes so the new sensor is learned.
If the low-pressure warning stays on after correct inflation and that drive, have the tires and system checked by a qualified shop.
tpms.note: If the warning light flashes first and then stays on, or the message centre shows a tire pressure monitoring system fault, the system itself has a fault. Setting pressures will not clear it.

notes: The 2011 handbook shows a SERVICE REQUIRED message when the service distance is reached but gives no driver reset, so no oil reset is listed.
